card.descGaming: Perfect for demanding games, live streaming and GPU-accelerated workloads requiring peak power. With its high-performance processor and dedicated graphics card, it delivers smooth gameplay in AAA titles, 3D design and AI-accelerated rendering at any resolution.
card.descBusiness: Engineered for professionals who need real-world performance without compromise. Ideal for HD video calls, heavy documents, complex spreadsheets and demanding multitasking. Robust connectivity, long-lasting battery and a high-fidelity display for flawless workdays.
card.descWorkstation: True workstation power for users handling massive datasets, 3D renders, CAD models or scientific simulations. Its multi-core processor and professional GPU combination delivers precise results even under the most sustained and intense computing workloads.
card.descCreator: The ideal choice for digital creatives. Perfect for editing 4K video, processing RAW photography, designing in Adobe Suite or managing professional audio projects. Its accurate display and balanced CPU-GPU remove every bottleneck from your creative workflow.
card.descUltrabook: Elegant, quiet and incredibly portable, built for professionals always on the move. Fits seamlessly into coworking spaces, business trips and remote work setups. Long battery life and an ultralight chassis without sacrificing performance or connectivity.
card.descBudget: The smart pick for those who want the best price without compromising quality. Ideal for office work, smooth browsing, online classes and everyday entertainment. Stable and reliable performance for every task you throw at it throughout the day.
card.descStudent: The perfect academic companion. Built for quick note-taking, research, organizing university projects and meeting deadlines. Light enough for campus life, with all-day battery and the multitasking agility needed to keep up with every open tab and app.
